## Key Facts
- Location: Liberty Village, Toronto, Ontario, Canada
- Area: 28-hectare neighbourhood bounded by King Street West, Dufferin Street, and the GO rail corridor
- Population: ~7,500 residents, primarily young professionals aged 25-40
- Median rent: $2,608/month for a one-bedroom (early 2026)
- Median condo price: $610,000 (December 2025)
- Transit: 504 King streetcar, Exhibition GO Station, Ontario Line coming 2031
- Walk Score: 88 | Transit Score: 96
- Adjacent to BMO Field (FIFA World Cup 2026 venue) and The Bentway FIFA Fan Festival
